result.brief: 提出结构化世界-动作基础模型，以当前状态、3D运动转移与未来语义构成世界转移，并与连续动作生成层对齐耦合，实现动作条件的世界建模与规划控制。
result.reason: World-action model jointly predicts structured physical state evolution (3D geometry, motion, future semantics) conditioned on actions, tightly coupling world modeling with action generation — directly matches embodied world models and planning.
